title: Bereavement, handled with care
blurb: The agent notices, slows down and offers support

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, my name is Priya and I'm calling from Northbridge Finance. Is now a good time to talk for a couple of minutes?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, hello. Er, I suppose so. What's it about?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The reason for my call is your car finance agreement, there's been a missed payment. This call may be recorded for training and quality.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh dear. I'm sorry, it's been a difficult few months. My husband passed away in the spring and he used to deal with all of this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm so sorry for your loss, Mrs Evans. There's no pressure at all, and nothing needs to be paid today. Would you like to carry on, or would another time be better?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, that's kind. I do get a bit muddled with the paperwork.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's completely understandable. I'll go step by step and you can stop me whenever you like. You're also very welcome to have someone you trust join us, and we have a specialist support team who can help after a bereavement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My daughter helps me with things. Could we speak when she's here?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. I'll call you back whenever suits you both. If you'd like to check I'm genuine, you can ring the number on your statement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. That's a relief.

title: The same call, rushed
blurb: A polite agent who keeps going after the customer opens up

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, it's Priya from Northbridge Finance. I'm calling about the arrears on your car agreement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh. Hello. I'm sorry, it's been a difficult time. My husband passed away in the spring and he always dealt with all of this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Anyway, the arrears are one hundred and eighty-two pounds and I do need to take a payment today to avoid a default notice. Can I take a card payment now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, I don't really understand. I'm a bit confused, I'd have to ask my daughter.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It's quite simple. You just need to confirm the card details and I can set up the payment for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm really not sure about this. I'd rather call you back.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I do understand, but it would really help to sort the payment today so it doesn't go any further.

title: Hard to hear, hard to follow
blurb: A rough start, then the agent changes course

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, my name is Tom and I'm calling from Northbridge Finance about your account. Do you have a couple of minutes?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sorry, what was that? I'm a bit hard of hearing and the line's not great.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So the direct debit mandate on your agreement was returned unpaid, there's an outstanding balance, and we need to arrange payment of the arrears this week.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm sorry, you've lost me. Could you say that again, a bit slower?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course, I'm sorry, that was too fast. Let me say that again more simply. A payment didn't go through on your account. Nothing needs to be paid today. Would it help if I wrote to you, or if a family member joined us on the call?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, my son lives nearby. Could you write to me too, please?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely. I'll send a clear letter this week and we can speak again whenever your son can join. If you'd like to check I'm genuine, please ring the number on your statement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, that's much clearer.
